Hi Jim Looking at previous posts you made, it sounds like you have a gmail account.

What version of Thunderbird are you using?

Are you talking about a gmail account ? Did you by any chance remove the account and then create it again ? I need to know what do you see in this location:

  • In 'Account Settings'
  • Select: 'Server Settings' for the account.
  • Make the window wide enough so it shows all the information including all the text in the 'Local directory: near the bottom
  • Take a screenshot and upload the image file to this form question.

This will me :

  1. if you are using a Pop or IMAP account
  2. the profile name folder
  3. the current account name folder it is currently using.

I'm asking for this information because in the past you used a Pop account set up, but then removed the account and when you created it again you set up as Imap. That meant all the pop folders would not be visible as you would only see what was on the server.
